people.name: Jeffrey Stephen Watts
people.bio_note: Co-founder of Watts Gwilliam & Company and member of its investment committee. Built his practice around clients who acquired wealth through closely held businesses, equity compensation, and professional athletics, with deep specialization in employee stock options and concentrated stock positions — he has taught seminars at some of the largest U.S. public companies on stock option tax consequences and diversification techniques. B.A. in Finance from the Marriott School of Management at Brigham Young University. Married to Kari, with five children; based in Gilbert. Outside the firm he's an endurance athlete — ultratrail running and rim-to-rim-rim Grand Canyon hikes.
people.bio_source: wattsgwilliam.com team bio page (firm's own website states his marriage to Kari, five children, and ultratrail-running/Grand Canyon-hiking hobbies, alongside his BYU education and stock-option specialization). ZoomInfo and SEC filings independently confirm his title, tenure, and Series 66 license. people.name: Daniel Bradford Gwilliam
people.bio_note: Co-founder ('Brad' Gwilliam), oversees implementation of option and investment strategies for client accounts. Finance degree from the W.P. Carey School of Business at Arizona State University. Spent 5 years at Merrill Lynch as a Wealth Management Advisor before co-founding the firm, with earlier experience covering the Midwest region and on the trading desk for a national mutual fund company. A third-generation Arizona native; his son Kimball joined the firm in 2022, carrying the practice into a second generation. Married to Jo, with six children; active in ASU football fandom, coaching kids' sports, and community volunteering.

people.name: David Bruce Watts
people.bio_note: Co-founder; focuses on financial planning and strategy for business owners, professional athletes, and other high-net-worth clients, with specialties in single-stock diversification, wealth transfer planning, tax minimization for employee stock options, and risk management. Co-developed 'Your Life Incorporated,' a financial-planning framework built specifically for professional athletes. B.S. from BYU's Marriott School of Management, where he played varsity football, followed by a Professional Financial Planner designation from UC Santa Barbara. Before co-founding the firm, spent six years at Merrill Lynch & Co. (five in Los Angeles, one in Phoenix). Married to Lori, with five children, based in Gilbert; enjoys surfing, travel, and photography.
people.bio_source: wattsgwilliam.com team bio page (firm's own website states his BYU varsity football background and six years at Merrill Lynch & Co., five in Los Angeles and one in Phoenix). firm_note.text: Fee-only, fiduciary financial advisory firm headquartered in Gilbert, Arizona, serving investors nationwide (~$1.03B AUM). Positions itself around a conflict-free, institutional-style advisory model with specialization in high-net-worth clients holding concentrated stock positions, professional athletes, and business owners. Runs a proprietary covered-call strategy (IPOM - Income Producing Options Model) it has operated for over 11 years, and co-developed 'Your Life Incorporated,' a financial-planning framework built specifically for professional athletes' personal finances. Family-continuity dimension: co-founder Brad Gwilliam's son Kimball joined the firm in 2022, extending it into a second generation.
firm_note.source: Firm website (wattsgwilliam.com/about-us, /what-we-do, team pages): confirms fee-only/fiduciary positioning, IPOM strategy tenure, and 'Your Life Incorporated' athlete framework. Web search: confirms Kimball Gwilliam's 2022 join and family lineage; searched explicitly for third-party recognition (Best Places to Work, Inc. 5000, Phoenix Business Journal rankings, other press) and found none.
